maintenance_led.reason: Revenue comes from research and advisory subscriptions, conferences and consulting, not repairing or servicing installed equipment.

publicly_funded.reason: Customers are mainly private enterprises' executives and teams buying research subscriptions, advisory and conference attendance.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly through selling research subscriptions, advisory and events, with only occasional acquisitions.

mission_critical.reason: Research and advisory subscriptions are discretionary; customers can switch to other analyst firms without downtime or regulatory approval.

notes: Switching-cost judgment is borderline because of Gartner's strong brand and embedded advisory relationships.
